site.monitoring_location_name: Mississippi River at Baton Rouge, LA

satellite.collection_note: the collection is named on every request; the service picks one when the caller does not, and the default has moved between versions that differ by metres at this reach
satellite.elevation_reference: water surface elevation against a geoid model, as the product documents it; this is not a national vertical datum

satellite_other_version.why: kept so the version step can be recomputed rather than quoted

gauge.parameter_name: Gage height, feet above the gauge datum
gauge.elevation_note: stage is height above the gauge datum, so an elevation is stage plus the datum altitude; at this gauge the datum sits at 0.00 ft so the two coincide, which is a property of this site and not a general rule
gauge.approval_note: the daily record at this gauge is approved only through 2022 and the satellite record begins in 2023, so the overlap is against provisional values

unit_note: stage is feet, satellite elevation is metres; 1 ft = 0.3048 m

license.satellite: NASA data, public (EOSDIS data use guidance)
